key_insight: PMO-DDPG balances competing cobot welding objectives, reducing trajectory error by 66.4% and collision rate by 82.1% versus SAC in the evaluated settings.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support more accurate, safer, and faster automotive spot welding, with reported cycle times of 3.87 s and actor-only inference of 21.5 ms.
method: Train a deterministic actor with four critics for accuracy, smoothness, safety, and productivity.
Map six normalized physical reward components to phase-dependent objectives across approach, alignment, welding, and retraction.
Use a non-dominated policy archive for Pareto-guided selection while retaining actor-only online inference.
evidence_signal: Simulation and industrial evaluation, including 100 industrial trials, reported 1.08 mm trajectory error, 1.2% collision rate, 3.65 kJ energy use, and 94.6% success.
watch_item: Results are descriptive without formal significance testing; generalization beyond the evaluated settings remains unestablished.
paper_title: Multi-objective deep deterministic policy gradient for cobot trajectory planning in automotive spot welding
